key.name: poll-seconds
key.description: How often the bridge checks the private feed repository. The minimum is 60 and the maximum is 900. The default is 120.

key.name: undo-seconds
key.description: How long Done can be undone in the popup and the window. The default is 5. The minimum is 2 and the maximum is 30.

key.name: muted-bots
key.description: Bot ids that do not raise a notification. An empty list means every bot can notify.

key.name: hidden-bots
key.summary: Bots hidden from the popup and the window
key.description: Bot ids left out of the popup and the window. Their items and rows are not shown.

key.name: history-enabled
key.description: When on, Show done lists completed todos for the history window. When off, Show done lists no completed todos. Dropped items are never listed. The default is on.

key.name: history-amount
key.description: How many history units a completed todo stays in Show done. The default is 1. The minimum is 1 and the maximum is 999.

key.name: clipboard-enabled
key.description: When on, plain text copied on this machine is kept in local clipboard history. When off, new copies are not saved. The default is on.

key.name: clipboard-images
key.description: When on, copied images are kept in local clipboard history. When off, new images are not saved. Text copies are unchanged. The default is on.

key.name: clipboard-limit
key.description: How many plain-text clipboard entries to keep. The default is 50. The minimum is 1 and the maximum is 500.

key.name: clipboard-excluded-apps
key.summary: Apps left out of clipboard history
key.description: Window classes whose copies are not saved. The default list is common password managers. Matching ignores case.

key.name: clipboard-lookalike
key.description: Skip drops a single-line copy that looks like a password. Mask keeps that copy on this machine for 30 seconds and hides the text. The default is skip.

key.name: clipboard-search-fallback
key.description: An https search address used only when the browser's own search engine cannot be read. It must contain {searchTerms} or %s. The default is DuckDuckGo. Search the web does not open until that button is pressed.

key.name: history-unit
key.description: Hours, days, weeks, months, or years. A month is 30 days and a year is 365 days. The default is years.
